title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large skillet until crispy.
Beat eggs and grated Parmesan together in a bowl.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Add hot pasta to the skillet with pancetta.
Remove from heat and quickly stir in egg mixture, adding pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the tikka masala spice for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry marinated chicken until cooked through.
In a large pan, melt butter and sauté onions until golden.
Add garlic and remaining spices, cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and cooked chicken.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and garnish with cilantro.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: A fresh and crispy salad with romaine lettuce, croutons, and Parmesan cheese.
instructions: Wash and tear romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, toss lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Add croutons and Parmesan cheese.
Top with anchovy fillets if desired.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Delicious Mexican tacos with seasoned ground beef and fresh toppings.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning with water as directed on packet.
Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill shells with seasoned beef.
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream, and salsa.
